items.title: Is Ralph Lauren (RL) Fully Priced After Its Outlook Lift?
items.summary: Ralph Lauren has been a powerful long term winner. The real question for investors is whether today's valuation still lines up with the cash the business can generate. After such a strong multi year run, the stock's recent cooling raises a straightforward issue about what is already baked into the price. Over the past 5 years, Ralph Lauren has delivered a share price gain of about 235%, which puts a lot of weight on whether future cash flows can keep supporting that kind of market...
